children: traded higher after the contract research organization, during its 2026 Investor Day on Thursday, said it expects to reach the upper end of its previously issued financial guidance for this year.
The Wilmington, Massachusetts-based life sciences firm attributed the encouraging outlook mainly to a continuing demand uptick from its biopharmaceutical clients.

“The Company now expects revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share to be at the upper ends of their respective guidance ranges, primarily reflecting continued favorable demand from biopharmaceutical clients,” it said.

reaffirmed 2026 outlook indicated an $11.15–$11.45 range of non-GAAP earnings per share and a 0%–1% organic growth target for revenue, both of which are, however, now expected to reach the upper limits.
